verdict.rationale: Open WebUI clearly lets self-hosters bring their own API keys, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, or existing coding-assistant subscriptions as model backends (docs-19, docs-34, docs-35), satisfying the 'bring your own keys/subscriptions' half of the story. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of a token-usage or per-model/per-conversation cost dashboard or tracking feature anywhere in the docs. Missing for 10: any documentation of usage/cost accounting, per-model spend reporting, or per-conversation token counters.
